notes: Section 12 (Operational Health)'s 'ARP Not Enabled' tile computed systems.length - arpEnabled, silently merging systems confirmed to have ARP disabled with systems Active IQ never reported an ARP status for at all -- overstating a real security finding with unconfirmed ones. Same gap existed on the ASUP side (never-reported systems had no tile at all). Split both into real tri-state buckets: ASUP Healthy/Stale/Not Reported and ARP Enabled/Disabled/Not Reported -- 6 tiles instead of 4, each set now sums exactly to the real system count. Added an 'ASUP Never Reported' systems table alongside the existing stale one. Verified live: ARP Disabled (confirmed) is 305 systems, not the old merged 448 -- 143 of those were never actually confirmed disabled.
